title: kith-jmap: Method registered in wrong map silently returns unknownMethod
description: If a caller registers a peer method via Dispatcher::register() (owner map) instead of register_peer(), the role check passes (required_role=Peer, caller_role=Peer), but then the dispatch falls to the peer_handlers lookup which finds nothing and returns unknownMethod. No compile-time or runtime warning distinguishes this from a genuinely unregistered method. Inversely, an owner method registered via register_peer() would fail silently. The two registration functions are unguarded against misuse. Adding a debug_assert or type-level enforcement (e.g. separate types for PeerMethod vs OwnerMethod) would catch this class of error.
